findings.claim: ReportIfLocatedInCompilation drops every diagnostic whose location is not in source (including Location.None). Diagnostics that fire with a null or None location are now silently suppressed, e.g. MemberNeedsKey (MsgPack004) when FirstOrDefault() returns null. Only a hunk-local concern for security: the filter now sits in front of all reportDiagnostic calls, so any configuration-protecting diagnostic raised with a null location is lost. Whether this matters depends on whether such diagnostics exist; no MessagePackSecurity, UntrustedData or depth-limit diagnostic is affected in the shown hunks.

receipt_plan.detail: Read all this.reportDiagnostic?.Invoke call sites in TypeCollector.cs and confirm none protect security settings (MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData, MaximumObjectGraphDepth) and that none rely on Location.None to be reported.
